summary.text: The Fed held with two hawkish dissents. Quinn calls the meeting meaningless: the Fed cannot hike into an AI unwind, an oil supply shock and slowing growth, so December likely comes off the table while inflation keeps rising.

Single-mandate central banks (ECB, Bank of Canada) keep hiking into an energy shock, mostly to defend their currencies. Quinn ties this to gold: energy-short nations sell gold to defend currency while the dollar is strong, but expects the dollar to peak and roll over within weeks to months.

Gold broke below 3,900 to a one-year low even with bonds rallying. Both see forced selling (liquidity crunch, sovereigns). Long-run case intact, but step aside below the summer lows until it recovers them.

The AI trade is fracturing: Microsoft and Google capex guidance missed estimates (38B vs 45B, 51B vs 55B). Credit spreads widening, neocloud credit window shut, leveraged products unwound. Quinn shorts pops and expects a long bleed; maybe a first bullish semis call in 2027.

Oil-industry lesson: over-levered producers keep producing into a bust, so a supply glut lasts. The same applies to chips and data centers. Compute becoming a commodity is bearish for margins even if the technology is great.
Quinn's main call: long oil, early-2027 futures expiries. Prices rose through three months of pre-midterm peace with almost no positioning; the supply disruption forces US action after the midterms.
Inflation as an invisible tax feeding populism, unrest and anti-data-center politics; prediction markets missed Brazil's election.

The $6.36B Binance hack dents crypto sentiment. Felix is less constructive; Quinn is not long anything and sees no fertile conditions until next year. Bottom-ish signal, but time capitulation first; gold's new lows could be ominous for Bitcoin.

theses_text.OIL: Long oil into 2027: supply disruption is forcing action after the midterms and almost nobody is positioned.
theses_text.SEMIS: The AI capex cycle has turned (capex misses, shut credit window): short the pops, no buy before 2027.
theses_text.GOLD: Bearish near term on forced selling by energy-short nations; good long term, but step aside below the summer lows.
theses_text.BTC: Not long; the Binance hack and gold's new lows point to more chop, conditions improve sometime next year.
theses_text.USD: The dollar is near a peak and should roll over over the coming months as the Fed is forced to ease.
theses_text.STOCKS: An oil spike on top of the AI unwind hits growth stocks.
